## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes or feature it introduces.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project
- [ ] TypeScript strict mode passes with 0 errors (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Lint and formatting checks pass (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Unit and contrast tests pass (`npm run test` & `npm run contrast`)
- [ ] Size budgets are strictly met (`npm run size`)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] Full validation passes (`npm run check:all`)
